meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你把第一个智能体接入聊天频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你刚部署好智能体服务，需要把它连上聊天频道
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and trigger a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up the agent service and need to connect it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按步骤引导你建立第一个 NanoClaw 智能体并接到私信频道:先确认你的频道身份,再创建/复用智能体,最后让智能体经正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私信。
howto.when: 当频道凭据已配置好且服务在运行,你要求初始化第一个 NanoClaw 智能体时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化第一个 NanoClaw 智能体,频道用 Discord。
say.note: Claude 会引导确认你的频道身份并创建智能体。

say.text: 我要在 Telegram 上建第一个智能体,让它给我发欢迎私信。
say.note: 它会按脚本完成配对并发送欢迎消息。

say.text: 把第一个 NanoClaw 智能体接到 Slack,走一遍欢迎私信流程。
say.note: 它会询问你的 Slack 用户 ID 并创建智能体群组。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude guides you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: it resolves your channel identity, creates or reuses the agent, wires it to the DM messaging group, and sends a welcome DM through the normal delivery path.
howto.when_en: Triggers when channel credentials are configured, the service is running, and you ask to initialize the first NanoClaw agent.

say_en.text: Help me initialize the first NanoClaw agent on Discord.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm your channel identity and create the agent.

say_en.text: I want to create the first agent on Telegram and receive a welcome DM.
say_en.note: It walks through pairing and sends the welcome message.

say_en.text: Wire up the first NanoClaw agent to Slack and run the welcome DM flow.
say_en.note: It asks for your Slack user ID and sets up the agent group.
